title: Effects of Black Cohosh on Menopausal Hot Flashes
brief_summary: This study will assess whether treatment with black cohosh is effective in reducing the frequency and intensity of menopausal hot flashes. In addition, this study will determine whether or not black cohosh reduces the frequency of other menopausal symptoms and improves quality of life.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Resident of the New York Metro Area
* Postmenopausal
* Weight within 90% to 120% of ideal body weight
